sections.title: Consolidated A, EBITDA and Adj. PAT
sections.text:
Over the period from FY24A to FY26E, Consolidated A rose by 17.9% to reach 87,627.1. EBITDA ended FY26E at 15,882.1, having risen by 24.3% since FY24A. Adj. PAT rose by 10.9% between FY24A and FY26E, closing at 5,143.5. Over the period from FY24A to FY26E, Adj. EPS rose by 13.3% to reach 16.2. Consolidated B ended FY26E at 31.2, having risen by 28.9% since FY24A. Consolidated C rose by 21.4% between FY24A and FY26E, closing at 3.4. Over the period from FY24A to FY26E, Consolidated D rose by 1.2% to reach 16.2.

Consolidated E ended FY26E at 1.5, having fallen by 28.6% since FY24A.
